facts_used: R2: Apex Forklift Leasing (V-009) is on the Approved Vendor List with status 'suspended' because its liability insurance lapsed in September 2026. Suspended vendors are not eligible.
decision.explanation: The request is rejected because Apex Forklift Leasing is suspended from the approved vendor list after its liability insurance lapsed in September 2026, so it cannot currently be paid for purchases. The requester may choose a different eligible vendor or wait for the vendor's status to be restored and then resubmit. No other rules apply.

rule_checks.evidence: All required fields are present: requester (Marcus Bell), department (Warehouse), vendor (Apex Forklift Leasing), item description, category (warehouse_equipment), amount ($9,000), request date (2026-11-04), and justification (extra forklift for holiday peak).
Apex Forklift Leasing (V-009) is on the Approved Vendor List with status 'suspended' because its liability insurance lapsed in September 2026. Suspended vendors are not eligible.
Request amount is $9,000 and the Warehouse department has $45,000 remaining for Q4 2026, so the request is within budget.
Amount is $9,000 (at least $1,000) and manager sign-off is recorded as Elena Voss, so the sign-off requirement is met.
Amount is $9,000, which is under the $10,000 threshold, so the three-quote rule does not apply (only 1 quote attached, but not triggered).
Request is for a three-month forklift lease for warehouse operations, not gift cards, alcohol, or personal-use items.
Amount is $9,000, below the $50,000 high-value threshold.
Amount is under $10,000 and no sole-source justification is attached (sole_source_justification is false).
Vendor status is 'suspended', not 'probation'. The probation escalation does not apply.
Category is warehouse_equipment, not IT hardware or software.
Conflict of interest declared is false; no declared relationship with the vendor.
Memory M1 and M2 show only this same request PR-004 from Marcus Bell to Apex; no other request from the same requester to the same vendor within 7 days is on record.
